UnaMentis - Device Discovery Manager
Orchestrates multi-tier server discovery with fallback hierarchy
Part of Core/Discovery

UnaMentis - Discovery Tier Protocol
Defines the interface for discovery tiers in the fallback hierarchy
Part of Core/Discovery

UnaMentis - Discovered Server Model
Represents a server found through automatic discovery
